detailed_insights.headline: TVS overtook Bajaj because of scooters, and Bajaj's only scooter (Chetak) is barely talked about
detailed_insights.whats_happening: TVS passed Bajaj in two-wheeler registrations in August and September (8,684 vs 8,035 in September). Bajaj still leads brand-new motorcycles (7,821), but Honda (7,532) and TVS (6,668) lead scooters. Online, Honda Dio posts come almost entirely from dealers and accessory shops, Yadea dealers advertise 'Rs. 6,000 a month, no petrol', and Chetak has 37 posts in 26 weeks, only 14% from riders.
detailed_insights.why_it_matters: Working mothers and delivery riders are the fastest-growing scooter buyers. They are choosing between Honda, TVS and Yadea, and most never see a Bajaj option. Chetak is hard to find outside the Battaramulla showroom.

what_to_do.action: Put Chetak into 10 dealer showrooms where Dio and Ntorq are sold (Gampaha, Kurunegala, Galle, Kandy) with test rides
Match Yadea's monthly-instalment framing: publish a Chetak 'Rs. per month, Rs. 0 petrol' message in Sinhala
Build the petrol-scooter business case with Bajaj Auto using the scooter share in the registration data

signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Honda's scooter lead rests on dealer push, not owner advocacy, so real Chetak owner stories would stand out.

signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Desire for electric two-wheelers is emotional and young; Chetak can compete on the same feeling.

signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Trust in EV scooters is being won with stunts; Chetak can win it with Bajaj's service network.

signals.title: Yadea T5L buzz is mostly dealer marketing, with thin owner experience

detailed_insights.headline: Dealers are selling the carburettor RE at Rs. 1,889,000, so buyers now question the EFi's Rs. 2,075,000 price
detailed_insights.whats_happening: From early September, dealers from Jaffna to Pottuvil posted the same offer: RE 200cc carburettor at Rs. 1,889,000 with Rs. 400,000 down. One presenter says customers ask whether the price fell from about Rs. 2 million to Rs. 1.8 million. Reviewers compare the carburettor and EFi models on repairs and say both give about 30 km/l. The CBSL rule means buyers pay 60% upfront on financed vehicles, yet an Eravur dealer advertises Rs. 200,000–250,000 down.
detailed_insights.why_it_matters: Buyers now compare the EFi on price alone. Down-payment offers range from Rs. 200,000 to Rs. 400,000 while the rule says 60%, so buyers can't tell what's true, and the confusion reflects on Bajaj.

what_to_do.action: Publish one official price ladder: what the extra Rs. 186,000 for EFi buys (fuel injection, digital dash, BS6) and the service plan behind it
Issue a dealer messaging standard for down payments that matches the CBSL 40% rule and names the financing partner
Run a mechanic-education reel on EFi serviceability, since 'mechanics know carburettors' is the stated reason to pick the cheaper model

detailed_insights.if_you_dont_act: Sales shift from the EFi to the cheaper carburettor model, and mismatched finance claims could attract regulator or media attention.

signals.title: Dealers across Sri Lanka are all pushing the RE 200cc carburettor at Rs. 1,889,000
signals.what_we_see: Dealers in Jaffna, Negombo, Ibbagamuwa, Matara, Galle, Matale, Batticaloa and Pottuvil ran the same offer: Rs. 1,889,000 with Rs. 400,000 down, plus trade-ins and leasing. Buyers ask whether the price is now below Rs. 2 million.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The carburettor model is now the reference price for three-wheelers, so buyers judge the EFi on the Rs. 186,000 gap.

signals.title: Three-wheeler buyers are choosing the cheaper carburettor RE because local mechanics know it
signals.what_we_see: Buyers are walked through injector vs carburettor on maintenance and mileage. Local mechanics' familiarity with carburettors is treated as an advantage over the EFi's digital display and fuel injection.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The EFi needs a mechanic-education and service-plan story to justify its higher price.

signals.title: Dealers push RE EFi upgrades with trade-ins and '1% interest' offers
signals.what_we_see: Dealer and creator posts frame the RE EFi 236cc as a replacement for an old tuk, offering one-day leasing approval, 1% interest and minimal guarantors.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Too-good-to-be-true finance claims risk backlash amid leasing fears; set clear dealer rules.

signals.title: News pages are explaining the new loan rules as '60% cash upfront'
signals.what_we_see: After the Central Bank tightened vehicle loan limits on 25 May, news and finance pages in English, Sinhala and Tamil summed it up in one figure: buyers now pay 60% themselves. People already mid-purchase asked about exemptions.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Buyers now read every three-wheeler offer against '60% upfront', so dealer ads promising Rs. 200,000 down will look misleading.

signals.title: An Eravur dealer keeps advertising customised tuks with Rs. 200,000–250,000 down
signals.what_we_see: The same Eravur dealer posted near-identical sale videos weeks apart, leading with down payments of Rs. 200,000 and 250,000 and showing custom paint, chrome and speakers.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Advertised down payments this low are below what the 40% financing cap implies; dealer finance claims need checking.

detailed_insights.headline: Fuel costs are pushing drivers toward electric three-wheelers, but only dealers are talking about them
detailed_insights.whats_happening: Petrol 92 is back at Rs. 414 and three-wheelers are limited to 20 litres a week under the QR quota. Dealers sell the Bajaj Wego electric three-wheeler on Rs. 60,000–70,000 monthly fuel savings and a 150 km+ range. Explainer videos from the 'Bajaj Electrical Threewheel Help & Support' page, such as 'can an older driver handle it?', get good engagement. Almost all other electric three-wheeler posts come from dealers, and posts about a locally built rival (Milton) praise it for replacing Indian imports.
detailed_insights.why_it_matters: Drivers want electric explained in petrol-tuk terms by other drivers. Bajaj has the longest certified range (176 km) and the biggest service network, but no owners are posting about it, and the 'local vs imported' debate is led by a competitor.

what_to_do.action: Film 5 owner diaries (Galle, Veyangoda, Kandy) on real monthly savings, charging at home and range on hill roads
Extend the explainer series to the questions drivers actually ask: battery life, resale, what happens in floods
Tell the Ranna assembly and local service story so 'Indian import' is not the frame for Bajaj EVs

detailed_insights.if_you_dont_act: Drivers come to associate electric three-wheelers with Milton and Chinese e-trike sellers, and Bajaj's electric model stays a dealer ad.

early_signs.text: Driver says he saves Rs. 60–70k a month
Local e-tuk praised for replacing imports

signals.title: Fuel costs are pushing three-wheeler drivers toward electric, but only dealers are talking about it
signals.what_we_see: Interest in the Bajaj Wego electric three-wheeler rises with fuel prices and the QR quota. Drivers ask about range, charging and the battery. Most posts are dealer ads with prices and phone numbers.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers trust other drivers. Owner stories will convert this interest better than more dealer ads.

signals.title: Drivers want electric three-wheelers explained in petrol-tuk terms
signals.what_we_see: Explainer videos answer what's inside the battery pack and whether older drivers can handle it, comparing every part to a petrol three-wheeler.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Explain the Wego part by part against the RE drivers already know.

signals.title: Dealers sell electric three-wheelers on fuel savings and easy finance
signals.what_we_see: All posts are dealer or manufacturer promotion for one electric three-wheeler, built on rising fuel costs, instant availability, trade-ins and low down payments. No owner voice.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The savings message is right but needs drivers to say it, not dealers.

signals.title: Bajaj's electric three-wheeler is promoted on daily-payment affordability
signals.what_we_see: Branded and financier posts push the Bajaj RE electric on daily payments and low running cost. No owner posts yet.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The affordability pitch is in place; owner stories are the missing piece.

signals.title: Mahindra's distributor is answering EV charging worries with an adapter
signals.what_we_see: All posts are Mahindra distributor content promoting an adapter for existing charging networks, lower running costs and a five-year battery warranty.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Charging is the top EV objection; Bajaj needs a clear charging answer for the Wego.

signals.title: A locally built electric three-wheeler is being celebrated as national pride
signals.what_we_see: Posts share the story of a Polgahawela entrepreneur building electric three-wheelers, praising near-zero running cost and long range, and framing it as replacing Indian imports.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: A local rival is claiming the 'made in Sri Lanka' story; Bajaj should tell its own local assembly and service story.

signals.title: Fuel costs and national pride are driving support for the local electric three-wheeler
signals.what_we_see: People praise the local e-tuk for no petrol, no engine oil and about Rs. 2 per km, say the savings pay the lease, and call for state and bank support.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The running-cost story is winning; Bajaj Wego needs the same message with an owner's voice.

signals.title: People say fuel prices rise fast but never fall when crude drops
signals.what_we_see: Consumers point out world prices returned to pre-war levels while local petrol stayed near Rs. 434, and accuse the energy minister of applying the formula one way.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Distrust of fuel pricing supports the case for electric three-wheelers.

signals.title: Drivers say the Rs. 15–20 fuel cut is too small to change fares
signals.what_we_see: Consumers and three-wheeler associations welcomed the August cut but said it doesn't offset earlier hikes or rising flour and milk powder prices, and asked for more.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers' costs remain high; finance terms decide purchases more than small fuel changes.

detailed_insights.whats_happening: On 23 August a State Minister proposed raising the minimum three-wheeler driving age to 40. People responded (one Tamil post reached 12,653 engagements) that buying a tuk is how many young people start earning after school. On 11 October the President announced public-sector pay rises from January 2027 (teachers to Rs. 65,000, doctors to Rs. 94,000) and 121,000 new recruits. DPMC's Rajya Pranama offer for government employees launched on 11 August and got no posts from customers.
detailed_insights.why_it_matters: The age proposal would cut out the youngest three-wheeler buyers. The pay rise gives government employees, the Rajya Pranama audience, a clear reason to buy in January. The 12 November Budget will confirm both.

what_to_do.action: Re-launch Rajya Pranama in the first pay week of January 2027 with the real salary figures in the creative, in all three languages
Prepare a submission on the age proposal with data on young owner-drivers and road-safety training as the alternative

detailed_insights.if_you_dont_act: Rajya Pranama keeps getting no response, and the age rule passes without input from the industry.

early_topics.what_we_see: Creators promoted the new RE EFi; few customer posts.

signals.title: Young riders post their Pulsar N160 purchase as a personal achievement
signals.what_we_see: New owners post handover photos, thank the showroom by name, film close-ups of badges and decals, and customise the bike. Much of the N160 conversation, though, is dealer discount ads.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Handover and styling posts are what young buyers share; dealer offer posts get far less attention.

signals.title: Young buyers still want the discontinued Pulsar 135LS as a first bike
signals.what_we_see: Reviewers ask why people still look for the 135LS in 2026 and point to its light weight, agility in traffic and fuel economy. It is no longer sold new, but used demand stays strong.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: There is an open slot for a light, sporty, economical first bike; the N125 could take it.

signals.title: Young owners rebuild basic Platina 100s and film every stage
signals.what_we_see: Riders post full teardown-and-rebuild videos of Platina 100s, focusing on cheap visual upgrades like springs, rim tape, decals and LED lights, with proud captions and close-up montages.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Owner rebuild videos are free, high-engagement content for the Platina; Bajaj can feature them.

signals.title: Owners show off modified CT 100s and Pulsar 150s, including to their mothers
signals.what_we_see: Owners add decals, grips, exhausts and stickers to entry-level Bajaj bikes and post slow-motion tours. Two creators framed the reveal as showing their mother 'the bike I told you about'.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Affordable Bajaj bikes are proud possessions for young owners; family-pride stories fit the brand.

signals.title: Pulsar N160 owners stage their bikes in cinematic videos with personal decals
signals.what_we_see: Owners film staged videos with slow pans and soft light, add custom red accents and decals such as '46 THE DOCTOR', and caption in Sinhala with emotional emoji.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: N160 owners already produce brand-quality content; a repost programme would amplify it.

signals.title: Pulsar NS200 owners treat the bike as an identity statement and debate it against the Yamaha MT-15
signals.what_we_see: Owners post styled pride-of-ownership videos, compare the NS200 with the MT-15 on engine, looks and price, and share technical walkthroughs and part swaps. Dealers promote it heavily alongside.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The NS200 has an active enthusiast base; the MT-15 comparison is the debate Bajaj should be part of.

signals.title: Young riders post modified NS200s in before-and-after edits with biker hashtags
signals.what_we_see: NS200 owners share modification reveals and styled videos where the rider's look matters as much as the bike, tagged with biker community hashtags.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: NS200 content travels through biker communities; working with those crews reaches young buyers directly.

signals.title: Motorcycle posts in this group come entirely from two dealers' price lists
signals.what_we_see: All posts are templated price lists, discount offers and contact numbers from two dealerships. Buyers appear only as tagged names in delivery photos.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Dealer price-list posts don't build interest; Bajaj should give dealers better content than discounts.

signals.title: Platina owners present suspension upgrades and rebuilds as achievements
signals.what_we_see: Owners post teardown-to-rebuild videos of ordinary Platinas, with suspension upgrades singled out in celebratory captions and self-shot footage.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Same opportunity as signal 4: owner builds are the Platina's best content.

signals.title: A Nawalapitiya dealer is selling three-wheelers mainly through TikTok
signals.what_we_see: One rural dealership posts short videos of customised tuks, handover photos with handshakes and 'Sold out' captions, and a phone number, using TikTok as its storefront.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Rural dealers are already selling on TikTok; a simple content kit would help others do the same.

signals.title: Pulsar N160 Premium attention comes from spec videos, not riders yet
signals.what_we_see: Visible content is a feature-comparison video and a showroom walkaround justifying the premium (inverted forks, ABS modes, Bluetooth cluster). No rider reviews yet.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Seed the N160 Premium with real riders so the first reviews come from owners.

signals.title: CT 100 owner crews post washing and modding videos as group identity
signals.what_we_see: Content shows modified CT 100s with crew names like 'Villain Riders', bike washing and polishing as rituals, and close-ups of paint, decals and exhausts.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: CT 100 has a youth crew culture; Bajaj can sponsor or feature these crews.

signals.title: Three-wheeler buyers are choosing the cheaper carburettor RE because local mechanics know it
signals.what_we_see: Buyers are walked through injector vs carburettor on maintenance and mileage. Local mechanics' familiarity with carburettors is treated as an advantage over the EFi's digital display and fuel injection.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The EFi needs a mechanic-education and service-plan story to justify its higher price.

signals.title: Akurana riders post customised Pulsars and ask who owns the best one
signals.what_we_see: Riders share walk-around videos with aftermarket exhausts, windshields and name-printed seats, tag local friends, and ask in Sinhala who has the most beautiful Pulsar.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Local rider groups drive Pulsar pride; town-level rider meets would fit.

signals.title: Jaffna dealers are launching the Pulsar 220F with 'legend returns' messaging
signals.what_we_see: ST Motors, JV Motors and UFS Lanka in Jaffna promoted the returning 2026 Pulsar 220F within days of each other, with Tamil audio and booking numbers. No buyer posts yet.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The 220F isn't on DPMC's published line-up; confirm the supply route and warranty position.

signals.title: Dealers sell electric three-wheelers on fuel savings and easy finance
signals.what_we_see: All posts are dealer or manufacturer promotion for one electric three-wheeler, built on rising fuel costs, instant availability, trade-ins and low down payments. No owner voice.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The savings message is right but needs drivers to say it, not dealers.

signals.title: Dealers across Sri Lanka are all pushing the RE 200cc carburettor at Rs. 1,889,000
signals.what_we_see: Dealers in Jaffna, Negombo, Ibbagamuwa, Matara, Galle, Matale, Batticaloa and Pottuvil ran the same offer: Rs. 1,889,000 with Rs. 400,000 down, plus trade-ins and leasing. Buyers ask whether the price is now below Rs. 2 million.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The carburettor model is now the reference price for three-wheelers, so buyers judge the EFi on the Rs. 186,000 gap.

signals.title: Dealers push RE EFi upgrades with trade-ins and '1% interest' offers
signals.what_we_see: Dealer and creator posts frame the RE EFi 236cc as a replacement for an old tuk, offering one-day leasing approval, 1% interest and minimal guarantors.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Too-good-to-be-true finance claims risk backlash amid leasing fears; set clear dealer rules.

signals.title: Bajaj's electric three-wheeler is promoted on daily-payment affordability
signals.what_we_see: Branded and financier posts push the Bajaj RE electric on daily payments and low running cost. No owner posts yet.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: The affordability pitch is in place; owner stories are the missing piece.

signals.title: Fuel costs are pushing three-wheeler drivers toward electric, but only dealers are talking about it
signals.what_we_see: Interest in the Bajaj Wego electric three-wheeler rises with fuel prices and the QR quota. Drivers ask about range, charging and the battery. Most posts are dealer ads with prices and phone numbers.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers trust other drivers. Owner stories will convert this interest better than more dealer ads.

signals.title: Jaffna dealers relaunched the Pulsar 220F before any buyer asked for it
signals.what_we_see: Several Jaffna dealers launched campaigns within days of each other on a 'legend returns' theme. No buyer questions or reviews appear.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Demand for the 220F is unproven; confirm supply and warranty before it shapes the brand in the North.

signals.title: A Galle dealer's Bajaj three-wheeler ads lean on DPMC's 40-year reputation
signals.what_we_see: Ovigo Motors in Galle and Neluwa push new Bajaj three-wheelers with leasing, trade-ins and 'authorised DPMC dealer' trust messages. No buyer posts.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: DPMC's heritage and service network are strong selling points; give dealers ready-made versions of that message.

signals.title: A channel posts DIY maintenance tutorials for Bajaj three-wheeler owners
signals.what_we_see: Tutorial videos show owners replacing headlights, locking handles and mounting phones themselves.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Owners want practical how-to help; official Bajaj maintenance tips would be welcome.

signals.title: A local e-tuk maker answers drivers' objections in scripted videos
signals.what_we_see: The manufacturer's presenters answer hill-climbing, axle noise, maintenance cost and daily earnings questions, each ending with 'comment for details'.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: A competitor is answering drivers' questions first; Bajaj should match with its own explainers.

signals.title: Mahindra's distributor is answering EV charging worries with an adapter
signals.what_we_see: All posts are Mahindra distributor content promoting an adapter for existing charging networks, lower running costs and a five-year battery warranty.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Charging is the top EV objection; Bajaj needs a clear charging answer for the Wego.

signals.title: Drivers want electric three-wheelers explained in petrol-tuk terms
signals.what_we_see: Explainer videos answer what's inside the battery pack and whether older drivers can handle it, comparing every part to a petrol three-wheeler.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Explain the Wego part by part against the RE drivers already know.

my_personas.so_what: Hire drivers face the most pressure (fuel quota, 60% upfront, repossession worries) and see the most dealer ads. Young riders post about their bikes on their own. Working mothers and delivery riders are buying scooters and electric bikes where Bajaj has little presence.

signals.title: Public-sector pay rises from January 2027 are getting wide attention
signals.what_we_see: Coverage repeats the same figures in Sinhala, Tamil and English: teacher starting pay to Rs. 65,000 and doctor to Rs. 94,000 from January 2027, plus 121,000 public-service recruits.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: January 2027 is a dated buying moment for government employees, the audience for Rajya Pranama.

signals.title: The 17 October power cut knocked out fuel pumps and water supply
signals.what_we_see: An island-wide outage after a fault at Upper Kotmale stopped fuel pumps, caused queues and cut water supply. People shared damage to their equipment and blamed the electricity board.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Power reliability is a real worry for buyers considering electric; charging backup should be part of the EV pitch.

signals.title: People are comparing import costs with pump prices and questioning the fuel formula
signals.what_we_see: After the 30 September revision, people compared Singapore import costs (petrol Rs. 292, diesel Rs. 350) with pump prices of Rs. 414 and Rs. 392 and demanded the formula be published.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel cost frustration is high and specific; running-cost savings are a strong message for CT 100 and Wego.

signals.title: Fuel price changes are broadcast instantly in Sinhala and Tamil
signals.what_we_see: News channels ran the 30 September revision as breaking news with exact per-litre increases in both languages.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel news reaches every language group within hours; a same-day running-cost message can ride on it.

signals.title: People want the state to keep fuel prices controlled, not set by private firms
signals.what_we_see: After the energy minister's 18 October comments on letting private firms set prices, commentators called it profiteering and private distributors limited supply, causing queue worries.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Expect more fuel price volatility; EV and high-mileage models gain.

signals.title: Buyers are holding off until the vehicle import surcharge is lifted
signals.what_we_see: Importers advise buyers to wait or buy pre-hike stock. Reports cite the 50% customs surcharge and loan limits as pushing prices up, even as imports surged (316,000 vehicles, Jan–Jul).
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Some buyers are waiting for the surcharge to end on 31 December; a price-protection offer can stop them waiting.

signals.title: The 1 October fuel price rise spread through news bulletins, not personal posts
signals.what_we_see: News publishers relayed the same figures in Sinhala and Tamil: petrol 92 up Rs. 15 to Rs. 414, auto diesel up Rs. 10 to Rs. 392, super diesel up Rs. 50 to Rs. 528.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel is the headline cost; three-wheeler and bike owners feel each change directly.

signals.title: People say fuel prices rise fast but never fall when crude drops
signals.what_we_see: Consumers point out world prices returned to pre-war levels while local petrol stayed near Rs. 434, and accuse the energy minister of applying the formula one way.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Distrust of fuel pricing supports the case for electric three-wheelers.

signals.title: The Rs. 15 petrol cut was welcomed but called far too small
signals.what_we_see: At fuel stations, riders and three-wheeler drivers said the August cut helps a little, but not against earlier hikes, and is too small to lower tuk fares.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers' margins stay tight; financing and running cost matter more than sticker price.

signals.title: Vehicle import taxes are drawing scrutiny after a US complaint to the WTO
signals.what_we_see: People cite stacked duties and valuation methods pushing prices up, call it tax-on-tax, and question whether it breaches trade agreements.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Vehicle tax changes could move prices; watch the Budget on 12 November.

signals.title: Monthly fuel revisions are reliable engagement moments
signals.what_we_see: News pages ask for likes and comments around each fuel revision, and audiences expected relief after crude fell. The 30 August petrol cut spread with exact new prices within hours.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Plan running-cost content around each month-end fuel revision.

signals.title: People share fuel price changes as warnings, especially the Rs. 50 super diesel rise
signals.what_we_see: The 30 September revision was reposted with new per-litre prices, singling out the Rs. 50 super diesel increase as the biggest hit, alongside personal-finance worries.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Commercial and transport owners feel fuel rises most; EV messaging should target them.

signals.title: The rupee moving below 330 per dollar is seen as a recovery sign
signals.what_we_see: Posts highlight the dollar dropping below Rs. 330 for the first time in two months and describe it as a trend since late July.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: A stronger rupee could ease imported-vehicle prices; watch for room on pricing.

signals.title: News pages are explaining the new loan rules as '60% cash upfront'
signals.what_we_see: After the Central Bank tightened vehicle loan limits on 25 May, news and finance pages in English, Sinhala and Tamil summed it up in one figure: buyers now pay 60% themselves. People already mid-purchase asked about exemptions.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Buyers now read every three-wheeler offer against '60% upfront', so dealer ads promising Rs. 200,000 down will look misleading.

signals.title: Drivers say the Rs. 15–20 fuel cut is too small to change fares
signals.what_we_see: Consumers and three-wheeler associations welcomed the August cut but said it doesn't offset earlier hikes or rising flour and milk powder prices, and asked for more.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers' costs remain high; finance terms decide purchases more than small fuel changes.

signals.title: The May fuel rise landed during Vesak week
signals.what_we_see: News in Sinhala and Tamil reported the 30 May increase of Rs. 15–25 per litre across all fuels, the same week as Vesak.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Festival weeks can carry cost shocks; time promotions with care.

signals.title: Families film the Poson crowds in Anuradhapura
signals.what_we_see: People travel with family for Poson, filming crowds, temples, lit streets and night rides, and treat queues and traffic as part of the fun.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Festival travel is a family moment; three-wheeler and bike owners are part of it.

signals.title: The President promised to shield consumers from global fuel price rises
signals.what_we_see: News widely shared the 20 September pledge that fuel prices would be protected from Middle East-driven swings, with expectations of Budget relief.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel price relief is expected in the Budget; plan messaging for both outcomes.

signals.title: Private fuel firms are being called a 'fuel mafia' for limiting supply
signals.what_we_see: Reports say private distributors limit fuel releases citing losses of Rs. 100–163 per litre of diesel, causing queues, while the state plans 75 new CPC stations.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel supply worries add to the case for electric and high-mileage vehicles.

signals.title: Fuel price revisions get high attention because transport costs hit every household
signals.what_we_see: News accounts build anticipation before each monthly revision and focus on petrol prices.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Month-end fuel revisions are a recurring moment for running-cost messaging.

signals.title: The May fuel rise was announced alongside Vesak greetings
signals.what_we_see: News publishers posted the 30 May price rise in Sinhala and Tamil, wrapped in Vesak greetings and festive music.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Cost shocks during festivals land badly; avoid price-led ads that week.

signals.title: People travel to see Colombo's Vesak lights
signals.what_we_see: People film lit pandols and streets and share guides on where to watch in Colombo.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Vesak is a high-attention week; good for brand presence, not price offers.

signals.title: Residents filmed the Akurana flood as it happened on 17 October
signals.what_we_see: People shared footage of floodwater submerging the town within hours, with timestamps and before-and-after comparisons.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Floods hit Central province vehicles and dealers; check stock and service support there.

signals.title: People share Mahaweli river levels and flood warnings near Peradeniya
signals.what_we_see: Residents post river-level updates, landslide warnings and evacuation advice during heavy rain.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Flood seasons disrupt sales and service in the hills; plan service camps after floods.

signals.title: Weather officials warned of flash floods in October despite El Niño
signals.what_we_see: Forecasters said El Niño means intense short rains, not only drought, and named Western, Southern, Central, Badulla, Nuwara Eliya, Trincomalee and Batticaloa as at risk for 15–21 October.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: October flood risk affects showroom footfall and logistics in named districts.

signals.title: Polonnaruwa's Poson perahara is widely filmed and shared
signals.what_we_see: People post night videos of dancers and drummers and praise young performers.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Cultural festivals drive shared content; a light brand presence fits.

signals.title: Crowds travelled to see the record Millathe Vesak lantern
signals.what_we_see: People visited and shared South Asia's 'largest lantern', themed on the Patachara story.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Vesak spectacles draw huge attention (267,069 engagements); good for brand visibility.

signals.title: Ramadan 2027 countdown content is already building
signals.what_we_see: People post countdowns to Ramadan starting 8 February 2027, with crescent, lantern and iftar imagery.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Plan Ramadan offers for Muslim communities in the Eastern province and Colombo.

signals.title: Vesak greetings come almost entirely from brands and institutions
signals.what_we_see: Nearly all Vesak messages were formulaic bilingual greetings from companies, banks, schools and media.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Generic festival greetings get lost; Bajaj needs something more specific to stand out.

signals.title: Christmas countdown content started two months early
signals.what_we_see: People post day-counts to Christmas from mid-October with cosy imagery and classic films.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Year-end gifting and bonus season is already on people's minds; plan December offers now.

signals.title: Travel creators promote tuk-tuk self-drive rentals to tourists
signals.what_we_see: Affiliate creators push self-drive tuk rental with discount codes for one platform, handling permit worries.
signals.what_it_means_for_brand: Tourist tuk rentals are a small fleet-sales niche for three-wheelers.

sample_report.question: Should the RE EFi keep its Rs. 2,075,000 price now that dealers sell the carburettor RE at Rs. 1,889,000?
sample_report.sources_searched: Forevate signals and posts (export), DPMC price list, CBSL directions, published registration data
sample_report.summary: Buyers in every province now use the carburettor model's price as the benchmark and compare the EFi on the Rs. 186,000 difference rather than on features. Reviewers say both models give about 30 km/l, so running cost doesn't justify the gap; easier repairs by local mechanics favour the carburettor. Keep the EFi price, add a service plan and a clear explanation of what the extra Rs. 186,000 buys, and stop dealers advertising down payments the CBSL rule doesn't allow.

signal_index.title: Young buyers still want the discontinued Pulsar 135LS as a first bike
signal_index.what_we_see: Reviewers ask why people still look for the 135LS in 2026 and point to its light weight, agility in traffic and fuel economy. It is no longer sold new, but used demand stays strong.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: There is an open slot for a light, sporty, economical first bike; the N125 could take it.

signal_index.title: A proposed age-40 minimum for tuk drivers worries young Sri Lankans who rely on it for income
signal_index.what_we_see: After a 23 August proposal to raise the minimum three-wheeler driving age to 40, people said buying a tuk is the default income route after school. Many asked for jobs first and suggested a lower age band of 25–35.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: If the rule passes, Bajaj loses its youngest three-wheeler buyers; the industry should bring data on young owner-drivers before the Budget.

signal_index.title: Young owners rebuild basic Platina 100s and film every stage
signal_index.what_we_see: Riders post full teardown-and-rebuild videos of Platina 100s, focusing on cheap visual upgrades like springs, rim tape, decals and LED lights, with proud captions and close-up montages.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Owner rebuild videos are free, high-engagement content for the Platina; Bajaj can feature them.

signal_index.title: Owners show off modified CT 100s and Pulsar 150s, including to their mothers
signal_index.what_we_see: Owners add decals, grips, exhausts and stickers to entry-level Bajaj bikes and post slow-motion tours. Two creators framed the reveal as showing their mother 'the bike I told you about'.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Affordable Bajaj bikes are proud possessions for young owners; family-pride stories fit the brand.

signal_index.title: Pulsar N160 owners stage their bikes in cinematic videos with personal decals
signal_index.what_we_see: Owners film staged videos with slow pans and soft light, add custom red accents and decals such as '46 THE DOCTOR', and caption in Sinhala with emotional emoji.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: N160 owners already produce brand-quality content; a repost programme would amplify it.

signal_index.title: Pulsar NS200 owners treat the bike as an identity statement and debate it against the Yamaha MT-15
signal_index.what_we_see: Owners post styled pride-of-ownership videos, compare the NS200 with the MT-15 on engine, looks and price, and share technical walkthroughs and part swaps. Dealers promote it heavily alongside.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: The NS200 has an active enthusiast base; the MT-15 comparison is the debate Bajaj should be part of.

signal_index.title: Young riders post modified NS200s in before-and-after edits with biker hashtags
signal_index.what_we_see: NS200 owners share modification reveals and styled videos where the rider's look matters as much as the bike, tagged with biker community hashtags.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: NS200 content travels through biker communities; working with those crews reaches young buyers directly.

signal_index.title: Motorcycle posts in this group come entirely from two dealers' price lists
signal_index.what_we_see: All posts are templated price lists, discount offers and contact numbers from two dealerships. Buyers appear only as tagged names in delivery photos.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Dealer price-list posts don't build interest; Bajaj should give dealers better content than discounts.

signal_index.title: Hill-country youth say the tuk is often their only income option
signal_index.what_we_see: Reaction to the age-40 proposal says restricting three-wheelers is unrealistic where it is often the only accessible income, especially in hill-country areas, and that jobs should come first.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Same risk as signal 3; the hill-country angle strengthens the case Bajaj can make.

signal_index.title: Honda Dio 125 conversation comes almost entirely from dealers, not riders
signal_index.what_we_see: Every post is from a dealer or accessory shop: walkarounds, discounts, instalments, cash on delivery, and 'your dream Honda' handover imagery. There are no rider reviews.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Honda's scooter lead rests on dealer push, not owner advocacy, so real Chetak owner stories would stand out.

signal_index.title: Public-sector pay rises from January 2027 are getting wide attention
signal_index.what_we_see: Coverage repeats the same figures in Sinhala, Tamil and English: teacher starting pay to Rs. 65,000 and doctor to Rs. 94,000 from January 2027, plus 121,000 public-service recruits.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: January 2027 is a dated buying moment for government employees, the audience for Rajya Pranama.

signal_index.title: Platina owners present suspension upgrades and rebuilds as achievements
signal_index.what_we_see: Owners post teardown-to-rebuild videos of ordinary Platinas, with suspension upgrades singled out in celebratory captions and self-shot footage.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Same opportunity as signal 4: owner builds are the Platina's best content.

signal_index.title: A locally built electric three-wheeler is being celebrated as national pride
signal_index.what_we_see: Posts share the story of a Polgahawela entrepreneur building electric three-wheelers, praising near-zero running cost and long range, and framing it as replacing Indian imports.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: A local rival is claiming the 'made in Sri Lanka' story; Bajaj should tell its own local assembly and service story.

signal_index.title: Supporters say the local e-tuk can break India's three-wheeler monopoly
signal_index.what_we_see: Posts repeat running costs near Rs. 2 per km, minimal servicing and cheaper local parts, and frame the local maker as ending India's hold on the market.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Posts present Bajaj as the imported option; it needs a clear answer on local assembly and jobs.

signal_index.title: A Nawalapitiya dealer is selling three-wheelers mainly through TikTok
signal_index.what_we_see: One rural dealership posts short videos of customised tuks, handover photos with handshakes and 'Sold out' captions, and a phone number, using TikTok as its storefront.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Rural dealers are already selling on TikTok; a simple content kit would help others do the same.

signal_index.title: Fuel costs and national pride are driving support for the local electric three-wheeler
signal_index.what_we_see: People praise the local e-tuk for no petrol, no engine oil and about Rs. 2 per km, say the savings pay the lease, and call for state and bank support.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: The running-cost story is winning; Bajaj Wego needs the same message with an owner's voice.

signal_index.title: An Eravur dealer keeps advertising customised tuks with Rs. 200,000–250,000 down
signal_index.what_we_see: The same Eravur dealer posted near-identical sale videos weeks apart, leading with down payments of Rs. 200,000 and 250,000 and showing custom paint, chrome and speakers.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Advertised down payments this low are below what the 40% financing cap implies; dealer finance claims need checking.

signal_index.title: Riders switch from tuk stands to ride-hailing apps after comparing fares
signal_index.what_we_see: Users compare app fares with stand quotes (Rs. 250 vs Rs. 500, Rs. 280 vs Rs. 1,000), say they won't use stands again, and teach family members to book on the app.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Three-wheeler buyers are increasingly app drivers; Bajaj can tailor offers and messaging to them.

signal_index.title: The 17 October power cut knocked out fuel pumps and water supply
signal_index.what_we_see: An island-wide outage after a fault at Upper Kotmale stopped fuel pumps, caused queues and cut water supply. People shared damage to their equipment and blamed the electricity board.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Power reliability is a real worry for buyers considering electric; charging backup should be part of the EV pitch.

signal_index.title: People are comparing import costs with pump prices and questioning the fuel formula
signal_index.what_we_see: After the 30 September revision, people compared Singapore import costs (petrol Rs. 292, diesel Rs. 350) with pump prices of Rs. 414 and Rs. 392 and demanded the formula be published.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel cost frustration is high and specific; running-cost savings are a strong message for CT 100 and Wego.

signal_index.title: Fuel price changes are broadcast instantly in Sinhala and Tamil
signal_index.what_we_see: News channels ran the 30 September revision as breaking news with exact per-litre increases in both languages.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel news reaches every language group within hours; a same-day running-cost message can ride on it.

signal_index.title: People want the state to keep fuel prices controlled, not set by private firms
signal_index.what_we_see: After the energy minister's 18 October comments on letting private firms set prices, commentators called it profiteering and private distributors limited supply, causing queue worries.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Expect more fuel price volatility; EV and high-mileage models gain.

signal_index.title: Pulsar N160 Premium attention comes from spec videos, not riders yet
signal_index.what_we_see: Visible content is a feature-comparison video and a showroom walkaround justifying the premium (inverted forks, ABS modes, Bluetooth cluster). No rider reviews yet.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Seed the N160 Premium with real riders so the first reviews come from owners.

signal_index.title: Yadea GT 70 gets excited emoji reactions with no detail
signal_index.what_we_see: Posts about the Yadea GT 70 are emoji-heavy praise with no prices, specs or ownership experience.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Desire for electric two-wheelers is emotional and young; Chetak can compete on the same feeling.

signal_index.title: Buyers are holding off until the vehicle import surcharge is lifted
signal_index.what_we_see: Importers advise buyers to wait or buy pre-hike stock. Reports cite the 50% customs surcharge and loan limits as pushing prices up, even as imports surged (316,000 vehicles, Jan–Jul).
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Some buyers are waiting for the surcharge to end on 31 December; a price-protection offer can stop them waiting.

signal_index.title: The 1 October fuel price rise spread through news bulletins, not personal posts
signal_index.what_we_see: News publishers relayed the same figures in Sinhala and Tamil: petrol 92 up Rs. 15 to Rs. 414, auto diesel up Rs. 10 to Rs. 392, super diesel up Rs. 50 to Rs. 528.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel is the headline cost; three-wheeler and bike owners feel each change directly.

signal_index.title: People say fuel prices rise fast but never fall when crude drops
signal_index.what_we_see: Consumers point out world prices returned to pre-war levels while local petrol stayed near Rs. 434, and accuse the energy minister of applying the formula one way.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Distrust of fuel pricing supports the case for electric three-wheelers.

signal_index.title: The Rs. 15 petrol cut was welcomed but called far too small
signal_index.what_we_see: At fuel stations, riders and three-wheeler drivers said the August cut helps a little, but not against earlier hikes, and is too small to lower tuk fares.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers' margins stay tight; financing and running cost matter more than sticker price.

signal_index.title: CT 100 owner crews post washing and modding videos as group identity
signal_index.what_we_see: Content shows modified CT 100s with crew names like 'Villain Riders', bike washing and polishing as rituals, and close-ups of paint, decals and exhausts.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: CT 100 has a youth crew culture; Bajaj can sponsor or feature these crews.

signal_index.title: Three-wheeler buyers are choosing the cheaper carburettor RE because local mechanics know it
signal_index.what_we_see: Buyers are walked through injector vs carburettor on maintenance and mileage. Local mechanics' familiarity with carburettors is treated as an advantage over the EFi's digital display and fuel injection.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: The EFi needs a mechanic-education and service-plan story to justify its higher price.

signal_index.title: Akurana riders post customised Pulsars and ask who owns the best one
signal_index.what_we_see: Riders share walk-around videos with aftermarket exhausts, windshields and name-printed seats, tag local friends, and ask in Sinhala who has the most beautiful Pulsar.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Local rider groups drive Pulsar pride; town-level rider meets would fit.

signal_index.title: Jaffna dealers are launching the Pulsar 220F with 'legend returns' messaging
signal_index.what_we_see: ST Motors, JV Motors and UFS Lanka in Jaffna promoted the returning 2026 Pulsar 220F within days of each other, with Tamil audio and booking numbers. No buyer posts yet.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: The 220F isn't on DPMC's published line-up; confirm the supply route and warranty position.

signal_index.title: Dealers sell electric three-wheelers on fuel savings and easy finance
signal_index.what_we_see: All posts are dealer or manufacturer promotion for one electric three-wheeler, built on rising fuel costs, instant availability, trade-ins and low down payments. No owner voice.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: The savings message is right but needs drivers to say it, not dealers.

signal_index.title: Vehicle import taxes are drawing scrutiny after a US complaint to the WTO
signal_index.what_we_see: People cite stacked duties and valuation methods pushing prices up, call it tax-on-tax, and question whether it breaches trade agreements.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Vehicle tax changes could move prices; watch the Budget on 12 November.

signal_index.title: TVS King promotion dominates the three-wheeler conversation
signal_index.what_we_see: Five of six posts are TVS King brand or dealer promotion in Sinhala and Tamil, focused on leasing, trade-ins and free gifts. The only organic post is a used 2014 King resale.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: TVS King is out-promoting Bajaj in three-wheelers; Bajaj needs a clear single promise to answer.

signal_index.title: Monthly fuel revisions are reliable engagement moments
signal_index.what_we_see: News pages ask for likes and comments around each fuel revision, and audiences expected relief after crude fell. The 30 August petrol cut spread with exact new prices within hours.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Plan running-cost content around each month-end fuel revision.

signal_index.title: People share fuel price changes as warnings, especially the Rs. 50 super diesel rise
signal_index.what_we_see: The 30 September revision was reposted with new per-litre prices, singling out the Rs. 50 super diesel increase as the biggest hit, alongside personal-finance worries.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Commercial and transport owners feel fuel rises most; EV messaging should target them.

signal_index.title: The rupee moving below 330 per dollar is seen as a recovery sign
signal_index.what_we_see: Posts highlight the dollar dropping below Rs. 330 for the first time in two months and describe it as a trend since late July.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: A stronger rupee could ease imported-vehicle prices; watch for room on pricing.

signal_index.title: Yadea dealers prove scooter durability with fire and stunt videos
signal_index.what_we_see: Dealer videos show Yadea scooters hit, set alight and stood on, with 'it won't break' captions and the dealer's phone number.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Trust in EV scooters is being won with stunts; Chetak can win it with Bajaj's service network.

signal_index.title: Dealers across Sri Lanka are all pushing the RE 200cc carburettor at Rs. 1,889,000
signal_index.what_we_see: Dealers in Jaffna, Negombo, Ibbagamuwa, Matara, Galle, Matale, Batticaloa and Pottuvil ran the same offer: Rs. 1,889,000 with Rs. 400,000 down, plus trade-ins and leasing. Buyers ask whether the price is now below Rs. 2 million.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: The carburettor model is now the reference price for three-wheelers, so buyers judge the EFi on the Rs. 186,000 gap.

signal_index.title: Yadea T5L buzz is mostly dealer marketing, with thin owner experience
signal_index.what_we_see: Content is dealers pitching warranty (4 years or 50,000 km), lithium battery specs and 'back in stock', plus maintenance how-tos. Few owners speak.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Yadea's owner experience is unproven; Chetak can compete on service and trust.

signal_index.title: News pages are explaining the new loan rules as '60% cash upfront'
signal_index.what_we_see: After the Central Bank tightened vehicle loan limits on 25 May, news and finance pages in English, Sinhala and Tamil summed it up in one figure: buyers now pay 60% themselves. People already mid-purchase asked about exemptions.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Buyers now read every three-wheeler offer against '60% upfront', so dealer ads promising Rs. 200,000 down will look misleading.

signal_index.title: Drivers say the Rs. 15–20 fuel cut is too small to change fares
signal_index.what_we_see: Consumers and three-wheeler associations welcomed the August cut but said it doesn't offset earlier hikes or rising flour and milk powder prices, and asked for more.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers' costs remain high; finance terms decide purchases more than small fuel changes.

signal_index.title: Legal creators warn buyers to read leasing contracts before signing
signal_index.what_we_see: Explainer videos urge viewers to check lease and guarantor terms, warning that default can mean losing the vehicle and a large lump sum.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Leasing anxiety is high; clear, honest finance terms will build trust.

signal_index.title: Chinese enclosed electric trikes are pitched as cheap car substitutes
signal_index.what_we_see: Promoters post demos of enclosed electric trikes with AC, screens and power steering, framed as stable city commuters.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: A new low-cost urban mobility option is emerging; watch it as a long-term rival to three-wheelers.

signal_index.title: The May fuel rise landed during Vesak week
signal_index.what_we_see: News in Sinhala and Tamil reported the 30 May increase of Rs. 15–25 per litre across all fuels, the same week as Vesak.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Festival weeks can carry cost shocks; time promotions with care.

signal_index.title: Families film the Poson crowds in Anuradhapura
signal_index.what_we_see: People travel with family for Poson, filming crowds, temples, lit streets and night rides, and treat queues and traffic as part of the fun.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Festival travel is a family moment; three-wheeler and bike owners are part of it.

signal_index.title: The President promised to shield consumers from global fuel price rises
signal_index.what_we_see: News widely shared the 20 September pledge that fuel prices would be protected from Middle East-driven swings, with expectations of Budget relief.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel price relief is expected in the Budget; plan messaging for both outcomes.

signal_index.title: Dealers push RE EFi upgrades with trade-ins and '1% interest' offers
signal_index.what_we_see: Dealer and creator posts frame the RE EFi 236cc as a replacement for an old tuk, offering one-day leasing approval, 1% interest and minimal guarantors.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Too-good-to-be-true finance claims risk backlash amid leasing fears; set clear dealer rules.

signal_index.title: Bajaj's electric three-wheeler is promoted on daily-payment affordability
signal_index.what_we_see: Branded and financier posts push the Bajaj RE electric on daily payments and low running cost. No owner posts yet.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: The affordability pitch is in place; owner stories are the missing piece.

signal_index.title: TVS King dealers all lead with a five-year warranty and five free services
signal_index.what_we_see: Dealers in Battaramulla and Kirindiwela and a TVS page repeat the same warranty-and-free-service bundle, adding low entry payments (Rs. 460,000) and free gifts.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: TVS sells one clear promise; Bajaj three-wheelers need an equally simple one.

signal_index.title: PickMe's win over Uber is celebrated as local business pride
signal_index.what_we_see: Writers credit PickMe's tuk fleet, cash payments and Sinhala and Tamil apps for beating Uber.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: App-based three-wheeler work keeps growing; Bajaj can partner with ride-hailing platforms.

signal_index.title: Fuel costs are pushing three-wheeler drivers toward electric, but only dealers are talking about it
signal_index.what_we_see: Interest in the Bajaj Wego electric three-wheeler rises with fuel prices and the QR quota. Drivers ask about range, charging and the battery. Most posts are dealer ads with prices and phone numbers.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers trust other drivers. Owner stories will convert this interest better than more dealer ads.

signal_index.title: Jaffna dealers relaunched the Pulsar 220F before any buyer asked for it
signal_index.what_we_see: Several Jaffna dealers launched campaigns within days of each other on a 'legend returns' theme. No buyer questions or reviews appear.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Demand for the 220F is unproven; confirm supply and warranty before it shapes the brand in the North.

signal_index.title: Lease borrowers are celebrating the police ruling against forced repossession
signal_index.what_we_see: After police said on 27 September that leasing companies can't seize vehicles by force, borrowers celebrated and called repossession agents a 'mafia'. A lease-payers' association reel reached 34,750 engagements.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Buyers now treat easy-finance offers with suspicion, so '1% interest' and one-day-approval ads may backfire.

signal_index.title: A Galle dealer's Bajaj three-wheeler ads lean on DPMC's 40-year reputation
signal_index.what_we_see: Ovigo Motors in Galle and Neluwa push new Bajaj three-wheelers with leasing, trade-ins and 'authorised DPMC dealer' trust messages. No buyer posts.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: DPMC's heritage and service network are strong selling points; give dealers ready-made versions of that message.

signal_index.title: Private fuel firms are being called a 'fuel mafia' for limiting supply
signal_index.what_we_see: Reports say private distributors limit fuel releases citing losses of Rs. 100–163 per litre of diesel, causing queues, while the state plans 75 new CPC stations.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Fuel supply worries add to the case for electric and high-mileage vehicles.

signal_index.title: Lease defaulters back the court order stopping forced repossession
signal_index.what_we_see: People call repossession agents thugs, ask for court processes instead, and credit an MP for the change.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Same as signal 57: finance offers must be transparent.

signal_index.title: Fuel price revisions get high attention because transport costs hit every household
signal_index.what_we_see: News accounts build anticipation before each monthly revision and focus on petrol prices.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Month-end fuel revisions are a recurring moment for running-cost messaging.

signal_index.title: The May fuel rise was announced alongside Vesak greetings
signal_index.what_we_see: News publishers posted the 30 May price rise in Sinhala and Tamil, wrapped in Vesak greetings and festive music.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Cost shocks during festivals land badly; avoid price-led ads that week.

signal_index.title: Talawakelle tuk drivers held a joint Ayudha Puja for their vehicles
signal_index.what_we_see: Drivers decorated their three-wheelers and placed all keys on one plate for a collective puja, attended by traffic police and local officials.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Drivers see the tuk as their family's livelihood; Bajaj can support such community rituals.

signal_index.title: People travel to see Colombo's Vesak lights
signal_index.what_we_see: People film lit pandols and streets and share guides on where to watch in Colombo.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Vesak is a high-attention week; good for brand presence, not price offers.

signal_index.title: BYD cut its EV price by Rs. 2.7 million nine days after launch
signal_index.what_we_see: A commentator noted the BYD RACCO dropped Rs. 2.7 million within nine days of its 9 October launch, leaving early buyers out of pocket.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Buyers now distrust EV launch prices; keep Chetak and Wego pricing stable.

signal_index.title: A channel posts DIY maintenance tutorials for Bajaj three-wheeler owners
signal_index.what_we_see: Tutorial videos show owners replacing headlights, locking handles and mounting phones themselves.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Owners want practical how-to help; official Bajaj maintenance tips would be welcome.

signal_index.title: A local e-tuk maker answers drivers' objections in scripted videos
signal_index.what_we_see: The manufacturer's presenters answer hill-climbing, axle noise, maintenance cost and daily earnings questions, each ending with 'comment for details'.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: A competitor is answering drivers' questions first; Bajaj should match with its own explainers.

signal_index.title: Residents filmed the Akurana flood as it happened on 17 October
signal_index.what_we_see: People shared footage of floodwater submerging the town within hours, with timestamps and before-and-after comparisons.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Floods hit Central province vehicles and dealers; check stock and service support there.

signal_index.title: People share Mahaweli river levels and flood warnings near Peradeniya
signal_index.what_we_see: Residents post river-level updates, landslide warnings and evacuation advice during heavy rain.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Flood seasons disrupt sales and service in the hills; plan service camps after floods.

signal_index.title: Weather officials warned of flash floods in October despite El Niño
signal_index.what_we_see: Forecasters said El Niño means intense short rains, not only drought, and named Western, Southern, Central, Badulla, Nuwara Eliya, Trincomalee and Batticaloa as at risk for 15–21 October.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: October flood risk affects showroom footfall and logistics in named districts.

signal_index.title: Polonnaruwa's Poson perahara is widely filmed and shared
signal_index.what_we_see: People post night videos of dancers and drummers and praise young performers.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Cultural festivals drive shared content; a light brand presence fits.

signal_index.title: Crowds travelled to see the record Millathe Vesak lantern
signal_index.what_we_see: People visited and shared South Asia's 'largest lantern', themed on the Patachara story.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Vesak spectacles draw huge attention (267,069 engagements); good for brand visibility.

signal_index.title: Mahindra's distributor is answering EV charging worries with an adapter
signal_index.what_we_see: All posts are Mahindra distributor content promoting an adapter for existing charging networks, lower running costs and a five-year battery warranty.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Charging is the top EV objection; Bajaj needs a clear charging answer for the Wego.

signal_index.title: Drivers want electric three-wheelers explained in petrol-tuk terms
signal_index.what_we_see: Explainer videos answer what's inside the battery pack and whether older drivers can handle it, comparing every part to a petrol three-wheeler.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Explain the Wego part by part against the RE drivers already know.

signal_index.title: Ramadan 2027 countdown content is already building
signal_index.what_we_see: People post countdowns to Ramadan starting 8 February 2027, with crescent, lantern and iftar imagery.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Plan Ramadan offers for Muslim communities in the Eastern province and Colombo.

signal_index.title: Vesak greetings come almost entirely from brands and institutions
signal_index.what_we_see: Nearly all Vesak messages were formulaic bilingual greetings from companies, banks, schools and media.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Generic festival greetings get lost; Bajaj needs something more specific to stand out.

signal_index.title: Christmas countdown content started two months early
signal_index.what_we_see: People post day-counts to Christmas from mid-October with cosy imagery and classic films.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Year-end gifting and bonus season is already on people's minds; plan December offers now.

signal_index.title: Travel creators promote tuk-tuk self-drive rentals to tourists
signal_index.what_we_see: Affiliate creators push self-drive tuk rental with discount codes for one platform, handling permit worries.
signal_index.what_it_means_for_brand: Tourist tuk rentals are a small fleet-sales niche for three-wheelers.
